children: Hewlett Packard Enterprise posts record fiscal third-quarter revenue of $12.2 billion, up 34% year over year, driven by surging server demand. Server revenue within the Cloud & AI segment reaches $6.8 billion, a 35% increase from the prior-year period. The company says AI is becoming a multi-year growth driver, with its differentiated portfolio positioned to capture that opportunity at scale. HPE's order backlog also hits a record level, the company.
